Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Nikhil - 12 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Pihu - 9 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
3. Meenakshi - 37 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
4. The bathroom - a tap, a bucket, a mirror

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Nikhil stands in the living room. Meenakshi and Pihu stand near him.]

Meenakshi: "Today feels like a good day."

[Nikhil lies down on the sofa.]

Pihu: "Careful!"

[Nikhil flops down on the sofa.]

Nikhil: "How beautiful!"

[Nikhil sits cross-legged on the floor.]

Meenakshi: "Let's see."

Scene 2: The park - Day

Nikhil: "Pihu, look over here."

[Nikhil does push-ups.]

Nikhil (happily): "This is amazing!"

[Nikhil does yoga on a mat.]

Nikhil (surprised): "Mom, listen!"

[Pihu skips rope.]

Pihu (gently): "Let's see."

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

Pihu: "Let's begin."

[Nikhil folds his hands and prays.]

Nikhil: "That's easy."

[Nikhil lights a diya.]

Pihu: "Exactly right."

[Pihu draws a rangoli at the door.]

Nikhil: "What next?"

[Nikhil paints a picture.]

Nikhil: "Hey, look at that!"

[Nikhil draws a picture of the house.]

Nikhil (laughing): "Yes, all right."

Scene 4: The bathroom - Day

[Nikhil stands in the bathroom. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Nikhil: "So, here we are!"

[Nikhil brushes his teeth at the sink.]

Nikhil: "Show me too!"

[Nikhil takes a quick bath.]

Nikhil (excited): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
